name: Spindler Broodmother

facts.text: Level 81, 100,000 health. One or two newly-born spindlers hatch every few seconds while she fights.
When she dies, 20-25 underdeveloped spindlers burst from her body.
She mesmerises a random target every 20-30 seconds; her teleport is off for bot raids.
The Hibernian epic raid wiped at her once on 2026-11-05 (build 8d7baa3).

story:
The spindlers of Galladoria all come from one mother, and she has never stopped. The Broodmother is bloated past moving far, a sac of eggs on legs, and she does not need to hunt: the hollow brings her food. While she fights the young drop from her one by one and run at whoever is nearest. She lulls the strongest foe to stillness with a slow sway, as she lulls her eggs. And at the end, when her body fails, she gives the hollow everything she was still carrying, all at once. Raiders who celebrate her death too early have a short celebration.

Every spindler in Galladoria is her child, and she has never stopped. The Sylvan think she came into the hollow as an ordinary cave-spinner, small and quick, and that the sap made her into a mother and nothing else. She is bloated past moving far now, a sac of eggs on legs, and she does not hunt: the hollow brings her food, and her children bring her more.

While she fights the young drop from her one or two at a time, newly born and already hungry, and run at whoever is nearest. With a slow sway of her body she lulls her strongest foe into stillness, as she lulls her eggs. The first Living Server realm raid that came to her lost to her once, and had to be rescued by a band of the realm's best. And at the end, when her body fails, she does the last thing a mother can do. She gives the hollow everything she was still carrying, twenty or more half-formed young spilling out of her at once to avenge her. Raiders who cheer her death too early have a very short celebration.
legend: Kill the hatchlings as they drop, steadily, and never forget the last part: when she dies twenty or more young spill out of her at once. Healers ready, AoE casters stacked on her corpse before the killing blow. Break the mezz on whoever she lulls. Stack the AoE casters behind the tank before the last tenth of her health, with healers ready on the melee. When she bursts, everything dies in the first two volleys or not at all. Superstition says never kill her while standing on an egg sac. Nobody remembers why; everybody steps off one when she gets low.

aggro: The broodmother's sac shudders. Something inside moves.

loremasterTopic.text: The mother of every spindler in Galladoria. Her young drop from her as she fights, and when she dies she gives up all she was carrying at once.

bookPage: Aodhan writes: the Sylvan do not hate the broodmother as they hate the rest. They pity her. She was a little cave-spinner once, they say, quick and clever, and the sap made her into a mother and nothing else, as it makes everything down there into one thing only. She cannot move far for the weight of her eggs. Her young drop from her as she fights, and when she dies she gives them all up at once. The fire-keeper told me that the Sylvan sing a lullaby when they hear she is dead, not for her, but for the ones that never hatched.
